_comment: Counted-metrics ledger, family 'idle_wakeups' (#2137). See copies.json for the pin rules.
title: Idle wakeups per second
_toolchain: Copy and syscall counts follow the code, but which copies the compiler inlines does not, so a run on another toolchain is reported in warn mode and never turns CI red.
_band: 10 % (at least 5/s): three repetitions read 329.8..329.9 (tcp), 313.8..320.9 (ws) and 319.8..319.9 (udp). The rows are the 100 ms receive timeouts, about 10 per second per thread; a hosted runner can stretch a sleep, so the band is wider than the spread.
_goal: 0 everywhere (#2136 user story 18): nothing wakes on a timeout.

rows.basis: esp_transport_poll_read(ws_, kPollMs = 200) in the recv loop: 5 timeouts per second per link, only to re-check the stop flag.
